name: Godrej Nurture
description: Godrej Nurture is a residential development on LBS Marg in Bhandup West, Mumbai, set across 6.5+ acres with more than 2.5 acres of open space. It offers 2 & 3 BHK homes, each with a deck, in three towers planned around a two-level clubhouse with amenities designed for children.
curation: Next to the upcoming Metro Line 4 station and minutes from the upcoming Goregaon-Mulund Link Road
Only three towers on 6.5+ acres, with a deck in every apartment
A 16,000+ sq.ft clubhouse across two levels, with child-focused spaces such as a kids’ pool, hobby area, and dance studio
amenities: Kids’ play area and hobby area
connectivity: 2 min to the upcoming Metro Line 4 station
4 min to the upcoming Goregaon-Mulund Link Road
8 min to the Eastern Express Highway
24 min to BKC and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: Three residential towers rising beside a city road
